sources.eyes: Randel et al. 2014 eLife 3:e02730 (adult eye circuit PRC > IN1 > INton/INsn > ciliomotor neurons > prototroch); Jékely et al. 2008 Nature 456:395 (eyespot phototaxis by ciliary beat on the eye's own side)
sources.cilio: Verasztó et al. 2017 eLife 6:e26000 (cholinergic MC drives ciliary arrest, serotonergic Ser-h1 and Loop drive beating)
sources.startle: Bezares-Calderón et al. 2018 eLife 7:e36262 (collar receptor neurons > INrope, INarc > ciliary arrest and longitudinal and parapodial muscle contraction)
sources.cprc: Verasztó et al. 2018 eLife 7:e36440 and Bezares-Calderón et al. 2024 Curr Biol (ciliary photoreceptors cPRC > INRGWa, INNOS > ciliomotor neurons; UV avoidance and pressure response)

declarations.sign: every cell excitatory unless its type names a GABAergic or glycinergic transmitter (none does in Supplementary file 1)
declarations.connections: the CATMAID connectivity endpoint's outgoing partners per source skeleton: synapse counts per (pre, post) pair
declarations.cells: every skeleton of project 11 is a cell; cell types from the celltype annotations, classes from the Sensory neuron, interneuron, Motorneuron, muscle, ciliated cell and gland annotations
declarations.position: the skeleton's root node, in EM space (nanometres)

facts.name: eye light reaches the cilia
facts.source: Randel et al. 2014 eLife 3:e02730 (adult eye circuit PRC > IN1 > INton/INsn > ciliomotor neurons > prototroch); Jékely et al. 2008 Nature 456:395 (eyespot phototaxis by ciliary beat on the eye's own side)
facts.predicate: light on every adult eye photoreceptor (PRC) raises the prototroch ciliated cells' mean to at least 0.02

facts.name: lateral eye light is lateralised at the band
facts.source: Randel et al. 2014 eLife 3:e02730 (adult eye circuit PRC > IN1 > INton/INsn > ciliomotor neurons > prototroch); Jékely et al. 2008 Nature 456:395 (eyespot phototaxis by ciliary beat on the eye's own side)
facts.predicate: light on the left eyes alone gives the two sides of the prototroch means that differ by at least a fifth of their sum, and light on the right eyes alone reverses the sign of the difference

facts.name: the eye circuit
facts.source: Randel et al. 2014 eLife 3:e02730 (adult eye circuit PRC > IN1 > INton/INsn > ciliomotor neurons > prototroch); Jékely et al. 2008 Nature 456:395 (eyespot phototaxis by ciliary beat on the eye's own side)
facts.predicate: light on the eyes activates the circuit's named interneurons IN1 and INton above the response level and the ciliomotor neuron MC above it

facts.name: startle
facts.source: Bezares-Calderón et al. 2018 eLife 7:e36262 (collar receptor neurons > INrope, INarc > ciliary arrest and longitudinal and parapodial muscle contraction)
facts.predicate: a stimulus on the collar receptor neurons (hCR, ventralpygCR) raises the mean of the longitudinal and parapodial muscles (MUSlong, MUSac, MUSchae) above the response level and raises MC above it

facts.name: ciliary photoreceptors reach the ciliomotor system
facts.source: Verasztó et al. 2018 eLife 7:e36440 and Bezares-Calderón et al. 2024 Curr Biol (ciliary photoreceptors cPRC > INRGWa, INNOS > ciliomotor neurons; UV avoidance and pressure response)
facts.predicate: a stimulus on the four cPRCs raises the mean of INRGWa and INNOS above the response level and a ciliomotor neuron (MC, Ser-h1 or Loop) above it

facts.name: specificity
facts.source: the circuits above are separate pathways in the reconstruction
facts.predicate: light on the eyes leaves the parapodial muscles (MUSac, MUSchae) below a tenth of what the collar receptors give them

explored.all: one exploratory settle of eye light at four gains preceded the freeze (no nulls looked at)
